claims.text: IV epoprostenol (prostacyclin analog) improves function and lengthens survival, even in pts unresponsive to a vasodilator at catheterization.
claims.quote: The prostacyclin pathway is targeted by IV epoprostenol, a prostacyclin analog, which improves function and lengthens survival even in patients who are unresponsive to a vasodilator during catheterization
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.text: Epoprostenol needs continuous central catheter infusion; frequent SE: flushing, diarrhea, bacteremia from the indwelling catheter.
claims.quote: Disadvantages are the need for continuous central catheter infusion and frequent, troubling adverse effects, including flushing, diarrhea, and bacteremia due to the indwelling central catheter.
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.text: Iloprost, treprostinil: inhaled, oral, SC or IV prostacyclin analogs.
claims.quote: Prostacyclin analogs that are inhaled, taken orally, or given subcutaneously or IV (iloprost and treprostinil) are available.
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.text: Selexipag: oral prostacyclin I2 receptor agonist; ↓mortality and morbidity.
claims.quote: Selexipag is an orally bioavailable small molecule that activates the prostacyclin I2 receptor and lowers mortality and morbidity rates
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1
